scenarios.name: Reveal the controls on a recent document row

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
recent documents are displayed in List View
a recent part row is visible
the user hovers over the part row
the row shows a selection checkbox and an actions control
the user opens the row's actions control
the individual document actions are displayed
